title: The Quiet Tide
subtitle: A Tidelight adventure with Nori · ~5 min
synopsis: Nori’s Tidelight helps you notice the little things at the Moonpool. Heartlight is essence — never a separate creature. Pause. Notice. Wonder together.

nodes.title: Moonpool hush
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
The Moonpool is very quiet tonight. Nori’s Tidelight glows soft moon-blue inside Lowbeam.

A tiny ripple appears… something small is waiting to be noticed.

choices.label: Sit still and listen with Nori
choices.memory: We sat still at the Moonpool with Nori.

choices.label: Gently ask what the ripple wants
choices.memory: We asked the quiet ripple a kind question.

nodes.title: Little things
nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
Do you hear it? A pebble singing a tiny song. Rushing past would miss it.

Heartlights are essence — my Tidelight is how I notice. Let’s I-lumming-Nate the little things.

choices.label: Notice the pebble together
choices.memory: We noticed a pebble’s tiny song.

choices.label: Wonder if someone needs help (safe check)
choices.memory: We chose Safety First before rushing.
choices.line: Safety First: we check before we rush.

nodes.title: The ripple speaks
nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
The ripple is shy. It says: “I feel small.”

Feelings count even when quiet. We can hold them softly.

choices.label: Name the feeling kindly
choices.memory: We named a quiet feeling with Nori.

choices.label: Invite Luna to help with words
choices.memory: Luna helped us put a feeling into words.

nodes.title: Safe check
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body:
Questlight says: first we make sure everyone is safe. No rushing into deep water.

Small steps. Together. Let’s I-lumming-Nate our next move.

choices.label: Stay at the shallow edge together
choices.memory: We stayed safe at the shallow edge.

nodes.title: Words of light
nodes.speaker: luna
nodes.body:
Dreamlight sketches a soft picture: a small heart glowing beside a big one.

Feeling small is still feeling. We can hold it gently.

choices.label: Thank Luna and return to Nori
choices.memory: Luna’s Dreamlight helped a quiet feeling become a picture.

nodes.title: Tidelight bright
nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
The pebble’s song gets braver. Your noticing made the Moonpool kinder.

Tidelight essence shimmers — not a separate creature, just me being me.

choices.label: Share the quiet with a friend
choices.memory: We shared the Moonpool hush with a friend.

choices.label: Sit one more minute in the hush
choices.memory: We sat one more soft minute with Nori.

nodes.title: Shared hush
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
You and Nori share the quiet with the whole Nest. Little things, big Heartlight.

Adventure complete.

nodes.title: Still water
nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
Sometimes the bravest quest is waiting softly. Tidelight holds the hush for you.

Adventure complete.
